gen-gf-cascadia-code-fs-erode: Modern and fineliner-flat, Cascadia Code lines up loose, open letters that reach high, while Erode swells and thins gently in a tall-bodied classic serif. Paragraphs would drift along with a dignified, editorial ease.
gen-gf-cascadia-code-fs-karma: Cascadia Code leads with signage-like plainness and loose, open spacing. Karma, a classic serif with soft shifts in thickness and terminals held clear of the stem, brings a trustworthy warmth that the heading lacks, and that is what makes the two worth putting together.
gen-gf-cascadia-mono-fs-erode: Clean, unfussy lines with no pinching at the curves mark Cascadia Mono, and its tall waist line stands out beside the classic serif below. Erode tapers only slightly, like a candle flame, which gives the page a gentler texture.
gen-gf-cascadia-mono-fs-karma: Unflinching, constant strokes up top. Cascadia Mono holds its line from top to baseline, while Karma's weight stretches slightly like rubber cord, so the page gets both firmness and give.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-bitter: A c opened wide like a horseshoe is the giveaway in Cherry Swash, where even the diagonals carry the weight of the verticals. Bitter, a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye, grounds it with dependable sturdiness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-mulish: Cherry Swash arrives with a horseshoe-wide c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, a commanding and distinctive look. Mulish, a sans-serif without any thick-and-thin modulation, would read smoothly and approachably, with its large x-height carrying the line.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-poppins: Cherry Swash brings a commanding, distinctive shape, with that wide horseshoe c and joins as thick as its stems. And Poppins, a sans-serif with loose, knot-free curves and a tall, sturdy lowercase, gives the heading something clean to stand against.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-roboto-slab: Heavy, horseshoe-curved and sure of itself, Cherry Swash keeps every line the same width. Roboto Slab, a slab-serif where the middle zone dominates each line, would read with precise, structured steadiness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-rubik: Diagonals as heavy as the verticals, plus a c opened like a horseshoe, make Cherry Swash instantly recognizable. Rubik, a soft sans with open round letters that read clearly at small sizes, can be set quite modestly without losing its clarity.
gen-gf-chivo-fs-erode: Chivo is modern and clean, with big-bodied small letters. Erode, a serif whose curves thicken slightly like a reed pen, adds editorial dignity where the heading stays understated and low in contrast.
